summary: Phase 40 testing completed - all features working correctly. Anonymous access gate, premium Lounge hub with 3 tabs (Market Narrative, Discussions, Early Access), and early access functionality all verified.

Backend: Free user gets full free-tier essays, 3-block preview of premium
Backend: Ask essay endpoint returns 401 without auth, 200 with auth
Backend: Narrative endpoint returns 403 for free user, 200 for premium
Backend: Admin can post narrative takes with tags (bullish/bearish/insight)
Backend: Premium users can react to narrative takes (toggle behavior works)
Backend: Invalid reactions return 400
Backend: Admin can delete narrative takes
Backend: Early access endpoint returns 403 for free, 200 for premium
Backend: Premium users can read scheduled drafts with early_access=true
Backend: Free and anonymous users get 404 for scheduled drafts
Backend: All regression tests passed (posts, briefings, auth/me, streak, early-supporters)
Frontend: Anonymous users see signin gate on essays with no content
Frontend: Anonymous users see locked ask essay widget
Frontend: Free users see locked Lounge gate with 'Go Premium' button
Frontend: Premium users see Lounge with 3 tabs (Market Narrative, Discussions, Early Access)

Frontend: Admin sees narrative composer with tag selection
